mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_USER ( USER_ID, PW, NICK, PROFILE_IMG, FAVORITE_SPORT, SPORT_LEVEL, UID_LEVEL, JOIN_DT ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{pw}, #{name}, #{profileImg}, #{favoriteSport}, #{sportLevel}, #{uidLevel}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, PW, NICK, PROFILE_IMG,FAVORITE_SPORT, SPORT_LEVEL FROM TB_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{id} AND PW = #{pw}
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS DUPLICATE FROM TB_USER WHERE NICK = #{nickname}
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS DUPLICATE FROM TB_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{id}
